# Director Pattern

A project Director keeps the conversation, delegates bounded work and evaluates
results. Select the actual package and preserve the project's existing authority
and canonical tracker.

- [For an agent](https://director.metal-sole.com/install.md): follow this guide directly for installation, verification or an explicit update; it points to the canonical GitHub protocols.
- [Canonical package](https://github.com/bladnman/director_pattern/blob/main/pattern/README.md): authoritative installation entrypoint.
- [Install/update selector](https://github.com/bladnman/director_pattern/blob/main/pattern/INSTALL.md): select the actual package and its preservation protocol.
- [Public rationale](https://github.com/bladnman/director_pattern/blob/main/development/RATIONALE.md): reasons and tradeoffs.

Reading is not adoption. Install/update only on an authorized request. Resolve
published main to an exact reviewed commit; the current package controls.
